Monthly Sentinel-2 time series for an area

Source: R/s2.R
fb_s2_monthly.Rd

Searches a STAC catalogue (by default Microsoft Planetary Computer) for Sentinel-2 Level-2A scenes, keeps per calendar month the scene with the smallest share of invalid pixels in the area (among the max_per_month scenes with the least scene-level cloud cover) (scene classification classes 0, 1, 3, 8, 9 and 10: no data, saturated, cloud shadow, medium and high cloud probability, thin cirrus), skips months with more than max_invalid invalid pixels, and resamples the bands bilinearly (the scene classification by nearest neighbour) to a common grid. The radiometric offset of processing baseline 04.00 and later is removed.

Usage

fb_s2_monthly(
  aoi,
  start,
  end,
  bands = c("B02", "B03", "B04", "B05", "B06", "B07", "B08", "B8A", "B11", "B12"),
  resolution = 5,
  max_cloud = 60,
  max_invalid = 0.2,
  max_per_month = 4L,
  invalid_classes = c(0, 1, 3, 8, 9, 10),
  stac_url = "https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/api/stac/v1",
  collection = "sentinel-2-l2a",
  dir = NULL,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

aoi

Area of interest: an sf or SpatVector object, a numeric bounding box c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in longitude and latitude, or a SpatRaster whose grid is used as is.

start, end

First and last date of the period ("YYYY-MM-DD").

bands

Sentinel-2 bands to read.

resolution

Pixel size in metres of the output grid (ignored when aoi is a SpatRaster); the grid uses the UTM zone of the area's centre. The pretrained models were developed on Sentinel-2 resampled to about 5 m (the Fields of The World chip grid), which is the default.

max_cloud

Upper limit of the scene-level cloud cover (percent) in the search.

max_invalid

Largest share of invalid pixels in the area for a month to be kept.

max_per_month

Number of scenes per month, those with the least scene-level cloud cover, whose scene classification is read to find the clearest one.

invalid_classes

Scene classification classes treated as invalid; add 11 to treat snow as invalid.

stac_url, collection

STAC API and collection.

dir

Optional directory where the stack is written (fb_write_stack()).

verbose

Print progress.

Value

An fb_stack of digital numbers (scale = 10000) with clear-sky masks; the scene identifiers are stored in the attribute "items".

Details

The scene classification misses some clouds, haze and cloud shadows, which then enter the series as clear pixels; look at the images (for example with fb_plot_rgb() for every date) and drop affected dates with fb_subset_dates(). In the southern hemisphere, choose a period that holds the summer growing season, for example July to June.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# about 1.6 km x 1.6 km of centre-pivot fields near Jovein, Iran; one scene per month of
# 2024 (needs an internet connection; takes a few minutes)
s <- fb_s2_monthly(c(57.436, 36.606, 57.454, 36.620), "2024-01-01", "2024-12-31")
s
fb_plot_rgb(s, date = 7)
} # }
